data.name: Anjit
data.gender_notes: Anjit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anjit is derived from the Sanskrit word 'anjas' which means peace. The suffix 'it' denotes one who is victorious in life. This name is believed to bring peace and success in all endeavors. The name Anjit carries the meaning “Peaceful, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anjit usually hope their child will grow to embody peaceful, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name imbued with the blessings of peace and victory.
data.etymology: Anjit belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Peaceful, Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anjit total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

historical_references.reference: Anjit is also mentioned in the Puranic literature as the name of a Yaksha king, who was the father of the goddess Parvati.
